Bittensor-x402 v1.0.0

- Initial release integrating Bittensor decentralized AI inference via Spraay x402 gateway with USDC micropayments.
- Supports four OpenAI-compatible endpoints: models listing, chat completions (SN64), image generation (SN19), and embeddings.
- No Bittensor wallet, TAO, or subnet registration required—just pay as you go with USDC on Base/Solana.
- Enables censorship-resistant, decentralized, and keyless AI inference and image generation.
- Designed for workflows needing decentralized infrastructure, Web3/crypto context, or trustless routing.
